# Creative Commons
> Creative Commons is the nonprofit behind the open licenses and public domain tools used worldwide to share knowledge and culture.

Creative Commons provides legal tools, guidance, and community programs that help creators, educators, institutions, and governments share works openly. Its website includes license deeds, legal code, chooser tools, policy and open culture resources, blog posts, and links to the broader CC network, certificate program, summit, search portal, and open source projects.

## About Creative Commons
- [Homepage](https://creativecommons.org/): Main entry point to Creative Commons, its mission, licenses, tools, and latest news.
- [Mission](https://creativecommons.org/about/mission): Overview of Creative Commons’ mission, values, and role in better sharing.
- [About](https://creativecommons.org/about): Summary of CC programs, initiatives, and organizational work across open knowledge.
- [Support CC](https://creativecommons.org/about/support-cc/): Ways to support Creative Commons through donations and other contributions.
- [Blog](https://creativecommons.org/blog): News, commentary, announcements, and stories from Creative Commons and its community.

## Licenses and Tools
- [Share Your Work](https://creativecommons.org/share-your-work): Starting point for choosing and applying Creative Commons licenses and tools.
- [Chooser](https://creativecommons.org/choose): Interactive tool for selecting an appropriate Creative Commons license.
- [Licenses](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/): Directory of Creative Commons licenses, versions, and related legal resources.
- [Public Domain](https://creativecommons.org/public-domain/): Overview of CC public domain tools, including CC0 and the Public Domain Mark.
- [Considerations for Licensors](https://creativecommons.org/share-your-work/licensing-considerations/): Practical guidance to review before applying a CC license.
- [Frequently Asked Questions](https://creativecommons.org/faq/): Answers to common questions about licenses, reuse, attribution, and public domain tools.

## Core License Deeds
- [CC BY 4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/): Human-readable deed for the Attribution 4.0 International license.
- [CC BY-SA 4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/): Deed for the Attribution-ShareAlike 4.0 International license.
- [CC BY-ND 4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-nd/4.0/): Deed for the Attribution-NoDerivatives 4.0 International license.
- [CC BY-NC 4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-nc/4.0/): Deed for the Attribution-NonCommercial 4.0 International license.
- [CC BY-NC-SA 4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-nc-sa/4.0/): Deed for the Attribution-NonCommercial-ShareAlike 4.0 International license.
- [CC BY-NC-ND 4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-nc-nd/4.0/): Deed for the Attribution-NonCommercial-NoDerivatives 4.0 International license.

## Public Domain Tools
- [CC0 1.0 Universal](https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/): Public domain dedication tool for waiving rights worldwide where possible.
- [Public Domain Mark 1.0](https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/mark/1.0/): Mark for identifying works already free of known copyright restrictions.
- [Public Domain Tools Overview](https://creativecommons.org/public-domain/): Introduction to CC0, the Public Domain Mark, and public domain concepts.
- [CC0 FAQ](https://creativecommons.org/faq/#can-i-apply-a-creative-commons-license-to-software): FAQ entry covering CC tools and common licensing questions.
- [Marking Your Work with a CC License](https://creativecommons.org/share-your-work/cclicenses/): Guidance on applying and displaying CC licenses on works.

## Legal Code and Versioning
- [CC BY 4.0 Legal Code](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/legalcode): Full legal text of the Attribution 4.0 International license.
- [CC BY-SA 4.0 Legal Code](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/legalcode): Full legal text of the Attribution-ShareAlike 4.0 International license.
- [CC BY-NC 4.0 Legal Code](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-nc/4.0/legalcode): Full legal text of the Attribution-NonCommercial 4.0 International license.
- [CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 Legal Code](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-nc-sa/4.0/legalcode): Full legal text of the Attribution-NonCommercial-ShareAlike 4.0 International license.
- [CC BY-NC-ND 4.0 Legal Code](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-nc-nd/4.0/legalcode): Full legal text of the Attribution-NonCommercial-NoDerivatives 4.0 International license.
- [Version 4.0](https://creativecommons.org/version4/): Background and resources related to the 4.0 license suite.

## Guidance and FAQ
- [Before Licensing](https://creativecommons.org/share-your-work/licensing-considerations/): Key considerations before releasing work under a Creative Commons license.
- [How to Choose a License](https://creativecommons.org/choose/): Decision support for selecting a license based on reuse preferences.
- [Marking and Metadata](https://creativecommons.org/share-your-work/cclicenses/): Instructions for marking works and communicating license information clearly.
- [FAQ](https://creativecommons.org/faq/): Central FAQ covering attribution, compatibility, commercial use, and enforcement basics.
- [License Versions](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/): Compare available licenses and versions across the CC suite.

## Policy, Open Culture, and Data Governance
- [Blog](https://creativecommons.org/blog): Ongoing writing on open culture, policy, AI, and data governance topics.
- [AI’s Infrastructure Era: Reflections from the AI Impact Summit in Delhi](https://creativecommons.org/2025/03/04/ais-infrastructure-era-reflections-from-the-ai-impact-summit-in-delhi/): Blog post on AI infrastructure, governance, and open ecosystem questions.
- [CC Hosts Open Heritage Statement Event in Amsterdam](https://creativecommons.org/2025/02/26/cc-hosts-open-heritage-statement-event-in-amsterdam/): Report on an event focused on open heritage and cultural access.
- [CC Licenses, Data Governance, and the African Context: Conversations and Perspectives](https://creativecommons.org/2025/02/19/cc-licenses-data-governance-and-the-african-context-conversations-and-perspectives/): Discussion of CC licensing and data governance in African contexts.
- [How to Keep the Internet Human](https://creativecommons.org/2025/02/11/how-to-keep-the-internet-human/): Blog post on preserving human-centered values online.
- [Semana de la Cultura Libre with CC Uruguay](https://creativecommons.org/2025/02/05/semana-de-la-cultura-libre-with-cc-uruguay/): Community story highlighting free culture activities in Uruguay.

## Community, Network, and Events
- [Global Network](https://network.creativecommons.org/): International community hub for Creative Commons chapters and network activities.
- [Global Summit](https://summit.creativecommons.org/): Information about the Creative Commons Global Summit event.
- [Certificate](https://certificate.creativecommons.org/): Professional learning program on open licensing and open practice.
- [Open Source](https://opensource.creativecommons.org/): Home for Creative Commons open source software projects and engineering work.
- [Search Portal](https://search.creativecommons.org/): Search interface for discovering openly licensed and public domain content.
